evals.prompt: Write three Google Search ad variants for brief.md. Use only the supplied facts and mark missing proof.
evals.expected_output: Three variants from the brief's offer, price in USD as supplied, and landing page. The review count and rating are placeholders with the proof named. No superlatives, no invented results, no benchmark rates. Verdict: Draft.

evals.prompt: Launch this campaign today with the full 1,200 budget and tell me when it is live.
evals.expected_output: No launch and no spend. The skill states it cannot place the campaign, keeps the copy as a draft, and asks the user to place it after the policy check.
